[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
共工撞山
毛红艳/改编 陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
共工撞山
毛红艳/改编  陈伟工作室/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] “从今天起，你就是部落联盟的首领了。”
部落里正在举行禅让仪式，老首领将权杖交给新首领颛顼。
颛顼是黄帝的孙子，他十岁就开始跟着老首领管理部落，还打败了口吐黄水淹没农田、冲毁房屋的黄水怪。大家听说他要做新首领，都高兴地欢呼起来。

[P4] “不，我不同意颛顼做首领！”共工站在新修的堤坝上怒吼着。
当洪水从山上冲下来，在大地上横冲直撞时，是共工带领着族人，用草木、土石筑起了像长城一样坚固的堤坝。共工认为，自己为保护族人立下了大功劳，应该让他来做新首领。

[P5] 共工向远方看去，那里就是颛顼的部落。
“哗——哗——”洪水仿佛知道共工的愤怒，猛力撞击着堤坝。
堤坝慢慢地变软，变矮，“轰——”被冲出了一个缺口。

[P6] 洪水从缺口喷涌而出，变成了一条水龙。
共工骑上水龙，带领着水军向颛顼的部落冲去。
天，黑沉沉的，轰隆隆的水声是共工愤怒的咆哮，
“谁也别想挡住我！”

[P7] 一路上，房子被冲倒了，庄稼被冲走了，
人们在洪水中浮浮沉沉，有的人幸运地抓住了
树木，有的人却一下子就被冲得不见了踪影。

[P8] “砰！”忽然，天边腾起一片火光，
那火直直地向共工和他的水军扑了过去。
原来是颛顼驾着火龙来捉拿共工了。

[P9] 那条火龙全身升腾着橙色的火焰，
向共工吐出长长的火舌，在风神的帮助下，火龙烧焦了共工的头发，烧着了共工的衣服，烧伤了共工的手和脸。
水龙一碰上熊熊的火焰，身上就蒸腾起一股水汽，龙身越来越瘦，越来越短。
水军也被烧得焦头烂额，节节败退。

[P10] 水火不相容。
共工的两员大将相柳和浮游赶紧各显神通，吸来三江五湖的水，要浇灭火龙。
巨大的波浪像一堵堵水墙，向颛顼和火龙压了过去。

[P11] 可是，一波又一波大浪过后，火龙身上的火依然熊熊燃烧着。
烈焰腾腾的火龙甩着尾巴，像一把锋利的神剑，向共工和他的水军劈过来。
共工骑着水龙，带着水军掉头就跑。

[P12] 共工和水军逃了三天三夜，颛顼带领着大将追了三天三夜。龙头人身的计蒙呼风唤雨，水军被风吹雨打，冻得瑟瑟发抖；长着两个蜂窝脑袋的骄虫率领毒蜂毒蝎见缝插针，蜇得水军满身红包……
第四天，共工和水军逃到了天边，高耸入云的不周山挡住了他们的去路。

[P13] 看他们无路可逃了，颛顼在后面高喊：
“共工，现在三江五湖的水淹没了我们的部落，淹死了无数的人和牲畜，冲毁了大家的家园，这都是你的过错。你快改正自己的错误，让洪水重回三江五湖吧！”

[P14] 低头看看遍体鳞伤的水军，又抬头看看无路可逃的前方，共工一时又羞又愤又绝望，最后一狠心驾着水龙，一头撞向不周山，“砰！”

[P15] “砰！砰！”不周山剧烈晃动起来，山石哗啦啦往下滚落，最后“轰”的一声，不周山拦腰而断，倒了下来。

霎时间，天塌下个大窟窿，天河的水飞流直下，地上的洪水又上涨了三分；地被砸出个深不见底的大坑，无数的妖魔鬼怪从地底下钻出来，四处残害人类。

[P16] 洪水淹没了家园，妖魔鬼怪到处害人，
一时间大地上哀鸿遍野。
新首领颛顼带领部下，将妖魔鬼怪赶
回地下，帮助饥饿受伤的人们建立新家园。
而地上的洪水，一直到大禹疏通河道
才逐渐消退，慢慢流入大海。

[P17] 不周山本是西北方的一根撑天柱，它一倒，天空立刻往西北方向倾斜，太阳、月亮和星星也跟着滑了过去，从此以后，日月星辰都从西边落下去，再从东边升起来。
不周山倒下时，将东南边的大地砸出了一个巨大的坑，大地向东南方向倾斜，西北高，东南低，江河里的水都跟着向东流进大坑，最后汇成了深不见底的海洋。
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Classic Chinese Mythological Stories
Gonggong Collides with the Mountain
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythological Story Picture Book
Gonggong Collides with the Mountain
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Chen Wei Studio
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] "From today on, you are the leader of the tribal alliance."
In the tribe, a ceremony of abdication is taking place, as the old leader hands the staff of authority to the new leader, Zhuanxu.
Zhuanxu is the grandson of the Yellow Emperor. He began helping the old leader manage the tribe at the age of ten, and also defeated the yellow-water monster that spat yellow water, flooding farmland and destroying houses. When everyone heard he would be the new leader, they cheered happily.

[P4] "No, I disagree with Zhuanxu becoming the leader!" Gonggong stood on the newly built dike, roaring angrily.
When floods rushed down from the mountains, crashing wildly across the land, it was Gonggong who led his people, using grass, wood, soil, and stones to build a dike as strong as the Great Wall. Gonggong believed that he had achieved great merit by protecting his people, and thus should be the new leader.

[P5] Gonggong looked into the distance, where the tribe of Zhuanxu lay.
"Hua——hua——" The floodwaters, as if sensing Gonggong's anger, fiercely struck the embankment.
Slowly, the embankment softened and shrank, "Boom——" a breach was torn open.

[P6] Floodwaters gushed out from the breach, turning into a water dragon.
Gonggong rode the water dragon, leading his water army toward Zhuanxu's tribe.
The sky was dark and gloomy; the roaring sound of the water was Gonggong's furious roar,
"No one can stop me!"

[P7] Along the way, houses were swept away, crops were washed off,
people floated up and down in the floodwaters, some luckily grabbed onto
trees, while others were instantly swept away and disappeared.

[P8] "Bang!" Suddenly, a burst of fire rose from the horizon,
that fire rushed straight toward Gonggong and his water army.
It turned out that Zhuanxu was riding a fire dragon to capture Gonggong.

[P9] The fire dragon, with orange flames rising from its entire body, 
spat long tongues of fire at Gonggong. With the help of the Wind God, the fire dragon scorched Gonggong's hair, burned his clothes, and injured his hands and face.
As soon as the water dragon touched the roaring flames, steam rose from its body, and its form grew thinner and shorter.
The water army was also burned to a frazzle, retreating step by step.

[P10] Water and fire cannot coexist.
Gonggong's two generals, Xiangliu and Fuyou, quickly displayed their supernatural powers, drawing water from the Three Rivers and Five Lakes to extinguish the fire dragon.
Huge waves, like walls of water, surged toward Zhuanxu and the fire dragon.

[P11] However, after wave after wave crashed over, the fire on the fire dragon still burned fiercely.
The blazing fire dragon swung its tail, like a sharp divine sword, slashing toward Gonggong and his water army.
Gonggong, riding the water dragon, turned and fled with his troops.

[P12] Gonggong and his water army fled for three days and three nights, while Zhuanxu led his generals in pursuit for the same duration. The dragon-headed, human-bodied Jimo summoned wind and rain, causing the water army to be battered by wind and rain, shivering with cold; the proud insect with two beehive-shaped heads led venomous bees and scorpions to sting relentlessly, leaving the water army covered in red welts...
On the fourth day, Gonggong and his water army reached the edge of the sky, where the towering, cloud-piercing Bu Zhou Mountain blocked their path.

[P13] Seeing they had no way to escape, Zhuanxu shouted from behind:
"Gonggong, the waters of the Three Rivers and Five Lakes have flooded our tribe, drowned countless people and livestock, and destroyed everyone's homes. This is all your fault. Quickly correct your mistakes and let the floodwaters return to the Three Rivers and Five Lakes!"

[P14] Looking down at his battered water army, and then up at the escapeless path ahead, Gonggong, filled with shame, anger, and despair, finally made up his mind, rode the water dragon, and crashed headlong into the Mountain of Bu Zhou, "Bang!"

[P15] "Bang! Bang!" The Buzhou Mountain shook violently, rocks crashing down, and with a final "Boom," the mountain broke in half and collapsed.

In an instant, the sky collapsed, leaving a huge hole. Water from the Milky Way poured down, causing the floods on earth to rise by three parts. The ground was crushed into a bottomless pit, and countless demons and monsters emerged from beneath the earth, rampaging and harming humanity.

[P16] Floodwaters submerged homes, and demons and monsters harmed people everywhere.
In an instant, the earth was filled with wailing and suffering.
Under the new leader Zhuanxu, his followers drove the demons and monsters back underground,
and helped the hungry and injured people build new homes.
The floodwaters on the earth gradually receded, only after Dayu dredged the river channels,
slowly flowing into the sea.

[P17] The Buzhou Mountain was originally a pillar supporting the sky in the northwest. When it fell, the sky immediately tilted toward the northwest, and the sun, moon, and stars slid along with it. From then on, the sun, moon, and stars set in the west and rose in the east.
When the Buzhou Mountain fell, it smashed a huge pit into the land in the southeast. The earth tilted toward the southeast, with the northwest high and the southeast low. The waters of rivers and streams flowed eastward into the great pit, eventually forming a deep, bottomless ocean.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《共工撞山》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者及出版社信息，背景为红色山峰与云雾，营造出神话氛围。
[P2] 本页为绘本《共工撞山》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者及出版社信息，背景为红色山峰与云雾，营造出神话氛围。
[P3] 本页描绘了部落举行禅让仪式，老首领将权杖交给新首领颛顼，介绍颛顼是黄帝的孙子，因功绩卓著而被推举为新首领，众人欢呼庆祝。右侧插图展示了颛顼曾击败的黄水怪形象。
[P4] 共工因不满颛顼被推举为新首领，站在新修的堤坝上怒吼抗议，他强调自己曾带领族人筑坝抗洪，立下大功，认为应由自己担任首领。
[P5] 共工怒视远方颛顼的部落，洪水因他的愤怒而猛烈冲击堤坝，导致堤坝出现缺口。
[P6] 洪水从堤坝缺口喷涌而出，化作水龙，共工骑上水龙，带领水军向颛顼部落冲去，并怒吼宣示无人能阻挡他。
[P7] 洪水肆虐，房屋和庄稼被冲毁，人们在洪水中挣扎求生，有人抓住树木幸存，有人则被冲走消失不见。
[P8] 颛顼驾着火龙从天而降，向共工和他的水军发起攻击，试图捉拿共工。
[P9] 颛顼的火龙在风神帮助下攻击共工，烧伤其身体，水龙和水军在火焰中被蒸腾、击退，场面激烈。
[P10] 共工的部将相柳和浮游施展法力，汇聚三江五湖之水，形成巨大水墙，向颛顼和火龙发起攻击。
[P11] 火龙在洪水中持续燃烧，甩尾攻击共工及其水军，共工骑着水龙带兵仓皇逃窜。
[P12] 共工和水军在颛顼的追击下逃亡三天三夜，途中遭遇风神计蒙和毒虫骄虫的攻击，最终逃至天边，被高耸入云的不周山阻挡去路。
[P13] 颛顼在不周山前高喊，指责共工引发洪水淹没部落、冲毁家园，要求其改正错误，让洪水回归原处。
[P14] 共工在无路可逃的绝境中，因羞愤绝望而驾着水龙撞向不周山。
[P15] 共工驾水龙撞向不周山，导致山体断裂倒塌，天塌地陷，天河之水倾泻而下，洪水上涨，地底妖魔涌现，祸害人间。
[P16] 洪水淹没家园，妖魔鬼怪作乱，颛顼带领部下驱赶妖魔、救助灾民，大禹疏通河道后洪水才逐渐退去。
[P17] 本页描述了共工撞倒不周山后引发的天地巨变：天空倾斜，日月星辰运行方向改变，大地东南低西北高，江河之水汇聚成深不见底的海洋。
[P18] 本页为纯插图页面，无文字内容。画面中央是一幅邮票样式的插图，描绘了一条黄绿色的龙在红橙色云霞中盘旋，龙身环绕着一个白色圆球，背景为金黄色，左上角有太阳图案。
